environment.real_cli_and_functions: CLI argparse and production functions run in process; no subprocess executable launched by fixtures.
environment.inference: Fixed synthetic embedding vector and schema-shaped model HTTP responses only.
environment.runtime_identity: Reader OCR/VLM/model identities stubbed; code hashes remain real; no Ollama /api/version or /api/tags requests.

runs.excluded: Two query tests deliberately not selected. Python 3.9 does not support existing zip(strict=True) in answer_local_memory.py; not counted as PASS.

runs.scope: 8 unchanged tests/test_semantic_lineage_relations.py cases plus all 7 test_reader_generation_migration.py cases under Python 3.14; in-process CLI/HTTP/model guards reused. Exact wrapper in accompanying executor notes.

expected_contracts: Version graph is explicit from bootstrap CLI through lineage/security context to source-bound independent Reader revalidation.
Legacy three-field unversioned context is supported; supplying null, unknown fields, omitted version on versioned Reader, or version on legacy Reader does not bypass validation.
Index metadata retains the validated version graph binding, and app publication hashes the complete index bytes.
Reader generation contract fingerprints resolver and safe-index-projector code and binds the fixed same-generation version artifact; changed version bytes or resolver code require migration.
Safe index stores only selected active version plus ungrouped evidence; historical source files remain untouched.
Human choice is exercised through real resolver decision persistence and application rebuild; changing the selected synthetic source invalidates the decision and holds both version candidates.
Failed rebuild retains prior published CONFIG and SQLite bytes.

Application build, publication, query retrieval, answer projection and final deterministic claim/orchestration gates run through real functions; synthetic model success cannot promote a blocked ambiguous Graph question.
limitations: Awaiting separate-context audit; executor does not approve its own changes.
No real-model quality, OCR, GUI, native HTTP server transport, cross-document graph trust, packaging or macOS installation acceptance here.
Three-layer V2 search and all version-selection semantics F02-F06 are unchanged; current explicit-year winner behavior is tested as existing wiring, not endorsed as correct policy for annual records.
F18 destructive lineage revalidation behavior is unchanged. Failure assertions target unpublished new generations, not revalidation of production user generations.
Python 3.9 query-path incompatibility remains; diagnosis already requires Python >=3.10. It is not silently skipped or fixed in this issue.
No claim of complete support for all file formats, security completeness or V1.00 final acceptance.

A first green candidate expected phase ready; it was corrected to ready_with_limits because historical files are intentionally held. Another fixture forgot to create the security directory and was corrected. An initial ambiguous owner query correctly hit the existing Graph hold; it was retained as a negative regression, with a separate generic positive question.
rollback: Review and reverse only the four owned source/test file changes, preserving all other working-tree changes and append-only run evidence; no destructive reset. Existing registered Reader generations conservatively request explicit rebuild after changed executable fingerprints.
next_action: Separate auditor checks task contract, code/test hashes, source-bound validation, negative fixtures and untested boundaries before root decides F01/F07 status.
